build_sweep_scripts: build SLURM batch scripts from a sweep config file for grid search hyperparameter sweeps
run_sweep_config_parser: run the script to parse a sweep config file with key=value pairs and comma-separated values
generate_grid_search_combinations: generate all combinations of varying arguments from a sweep config for grid search
create_slurm_job_scripts: create executable SLURM job scripts with GPU allocation and environment setup for each sweep combination
build_master_submit_script: build a master shell script that submits all generated SLURM batch scripts in parallel
